content:
CONFIRMED — Canonical history is not append-only. `CoreAgentSession` can restore a failed run to its pre-run `SessionDocument`, truncating run-added messages; later runs then reuse the same positional timeline sequences. An old cursor can consequently return replacement messages as if they were older history rather than being rejected as stale.

Concrete failure: with baseline sequence 1, run A reaches sequence 6 and returns a cursor `before=5`; a terminal commit failure rolls back to sequence 1; run B appends new sequences 2–4; following A’s old cursor silently returns run B’s sequences 3–4.

Exact current line: `E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\ji-java\applications\ji-host-web\src\main\java\io\github\diodeme\ji\host\web\LocalHostServer.java:785` — the cursor payload contains only encoded `sessionId` and `beforeSequence`.
